messages:
ana-docs: opened PR to standardize audit-log docs: switch examples to JSONL, add Node/Python/Ruby snippets, and a short SDK migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4315

rafa-legal: quick ask: keep SOC2 wording non-absolute. use 'access is restricted and governed by contract and policy' instead of 'never shared'. also avoid publishing fixed retention promises.

mike-devex: noted. also the Node example should emit newline-delimited JSON (console.log(JSON.stringify(r))) and Python should print(json.dumps(r)). will add tiny migration steps: JSON -> JSONL, client.log_event -> client.audit_log_write, REDWOOD_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS for Private.

julia-privacy: add demo-data guidance: remove PII but keep required keys with placeholders like "actor": "<REDACTED>". link to internal privacy playbook.

ci-bot: docs-lint -> failed: examples/audit-log/examples.jsonl record 3 missing required field "event_id". Triggered by PR #4315.

ana-docs: thanks CI. I'll add placeholders for redacted fields and an MDX note titled 'Placeholders vs required keys' explaining what can be removed for demos. also fixing internal link to /legal/data-retention.

rafa-legal: add compact export/legal-hold contact flow: 'For exports or legal holds contact legal@redwood.ai with the case ID and requester details.'

mike-devex: pushed small fix with placeholders and updated snippets. added a short migration checklist in the docs.

ci-bot: docs-lint -> all checks passed. examples validated.

ana-docs: merging after freeze window. will add changelog note and ping support/product. closing thread.
